question: How do I add custom billing information for enterprise customers to Ask Fern?
ground_truth: You can add custom billing information for enterprise customers using the guidance API. Create a guidance document with context texts that match billing-related queries (like "What billing options are available for enterprise customers with 10-50 seats?") and a document text containing your prescribed response (such as "Please reach out to support@yourcompany.com for more information."). The guidance will override default RAG responses when users ask matching questions.

metadata.cited_context: Guidance documents consist of a list of `context` texts and a `document` text. The `context` texts will be indexed to match against user queries. The `document` text will used as a prescribed response to the user query. Below is an example of a guidance document that can be uploaded via the `guidance` API: {"context": ["What billing options are available for enterprise customers with 10-50 seats?", "How do I upgrade the number of seats for my enterprise plan?"], "document": "Please reach out to support@yourcompany.com for more information."} Ask Fern prioritizes guidance response over other document responses, allowing you to override the default RAG responses.
